checkpoint.epoch_note: Optimizer stripping removes epoch; saved train_metrics corroborate CSV epoch 57.

discrepancy_investigation.interpretation: FP16 checkpoint serialization is a plausible residual explanation, not a proven complete cause. FP32 loading cannot recover the original full-precision EMA.
discrepancy_investigation.unresolved: Exact epoch-57 FP32 EMA reproduction is unavailable from the preserved stripped checkpoint. Official equivalence is not established.
verified: Checkpoint training metrics correspond exactly to the official epoch-57 CSV reference.
Validation image and label content matches the original CLAHE preprocessing manifest.
Native target geometry agrees with canonical original-pixel labels within 0.00008366 pixels.
Native conf 0.001, class-aware multi-label NMS IoU 0.7, max_det 300, rect=True, batch 16 and FP32 are reconstructed from the recorded protocol and pinned trainer/validator.
Both fusion modes miss mAP50 tolerance and reproduce their own exports exactly.
Pinned trainer validates the live FP32 EMA and serializes a separate FP16 copy; preserved checkpoint parameters are FP16.

evaluation_settings_reason: The pinned detection trainer doubles validation batch size and forces rectangular validation batches. Validation NMS defaults conf=None to 0.001, uses multi_label=True, class-aware NMS, IoU 0.7 and max_det 300. workers=0 changes loading concurrency only. A validation-only copy contains caches; no canonical split is rewritten.

framework.precision: FP32 inference from the preserved checkpoint

limitations: Candidates below confidence 0.001 or removed by NMS/max_det are unavailable; this is not a raw-head export.
Confidence-first diagnostic matching differs from Ultralytics' IoU-first AP matching on conflicts and ties.
The official AP reproduction check must pass before these candidates can be treated as an equivalent evaluation.
Standalone validation calculates detection metrics, not trainer-integrated validation losses.
Checkpoints serialize FP16 weights; the original full-precision epoch EMA cannot be recovered from this artifact.
Repeatability requires a separate fresh-directory run; it is not guaranteed across GPU/framework versions.
Empty labels are unannotated cases, not clinically verified healthy images.
Class-agnostic diagnostic matching uses candidates originally retained by class-aware NMS.
Stage 2 requires separate user approval and review of the failed official metric reproduction check.

matching.below_confidence_threshold: Excluded from matching and FP counts.
matching.duplicates: at most one prediction can claim a target; remaining predictions are FP
matching.empty_ground_truth: Every retained unmatched prediction is FP.
matching.input_guards: Finite ordered xyxy, unique nonempty IDs, nonnegative integer class IDs, scores in [0,1].
matching.native_comparison: Agreement on unambiguous synthetic fixtures; conflict fixture demonstrates different assignments.
matching.prediction_order: descending confidence then stable box ID
matching.target_choice: highest eligible IoU then stable ground truth ID
matching.wrong_class: unmatched prediction is FP; unmatched target remains FN

comparison.tolerance_reason: Chosen before evaluation: 5e-5 absolute AP allows the official five-decimal rounding (at most 5e-6) plus small checkpoint FP16 serialization/FP32 fusion differences. It is a tight reproduction check, not a statistical equivalence test.

prediction_export.ap_relation: Captured from the same framework validation pass; fixed-threshold matching is separate from AP.
prediction_export.purpose: Low-confidence post-NMS candidates for later error analysis

preservation.initial_capture_limitation: Tool output was truncated. Only 75 complete baseline hashes are retained, including every configuration and the three pre-existing Phase 2F evidence files.

primary_run.selection_reason: Native standalone default; retained regardless of metric failure.

resolved_implementation_problems: Native AP conflict behavior was verified against installed BaseValidator source and the synthetic fixture corrected.
Ultralytics configuration directories are created before import so settings/cache writes remain under ignored outputs.
An early repeat stopped before inference because the legacy checkpoint lacks yaml_file/scale metadata. Actual depth/width/nc fields are now recorded; the failed attempt and log are retained.

tests.fixtures: Synthetic only; no real held-out samples used by regression checks.

official_comparison.tolerance_reason: Chosen before evaluation: 5e-5 absolute AP allows the official five-decimal rounding (at most 5e-6) plus small checkpoint FP16 serialization/FP32 fusion differences. It is a tight reproduction check, not a statistical equivalence test.

unfused_diagnostic.purpose: Check standalone fusion versus unfused trainer epoch validation; no protocol or tolerance change.
unfused_diagnostic.result: Layer fusion alone does not explain the discrepancy.
